{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corporate Sector System Development Programs''', also known as '''D-Progs''', was a development project coordinated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]] that gave economic aid to frontier [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] that had suffered during the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was considered a success.
